name: What are the benefits of installing stairway lighting?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of installing stairway lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stairway lighting enhances safety by illuminating steps, reducing the risk of falls, especially in low-light conditions. Beyond safety, it significantly improves the aesthetics of your home, highlighting architectural features and creating a welcoming ambiance. Modern lighting solutions can also be energy-efficient, lowering electricity consumption. Additionally, well-lit stairways contribute to increased property value and make your home more functional and enjoyable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stairway lighting improves safety, enhances home aesthetics, and can be energy-efficient. It reduces fall risks and increases property value.
